evidence.label: 明确提出新的评测资料或框架
evidence.excerpt: To disentangle agent performance redundancy from a complete perspective, we propose DualViewEval, an agent benchmark compression method that jointly exploits outcome and process relations to learn an exact-size miniset and predict the full-benchmark scores.

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Benchmark compression is therefore a natural solution, yet existing methods primarily model redundancy in task--model final-score distributions, which is important in agentic evaluation.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: Across five agent benchmarks and five representative baselines, DualViewEval achieves the best results in all datasets.

evidence.label: 给出任务规模或覆盖范围
evidence.excerpt: With only 20 tasks, it achieves $24\times$--$40\times$ compression on APEX-Agents and BFCL, reducing mean absolute error (MAE) by $14.5\%$--$28.2\%$ over the strongest competitors while improving Kendall's $τ$ by up to $7.2\%$ relative to EssenceBench on SWE-bench Verified.
